pages.text: Put a $(item)Switch Stand$() within three blocks of the block where a line divides: trains heading for the fork go the way it's set.$(li)$(l)Normal$() (green target): the straightest way.$(li)$(l)Thrown$() (yellow): the branch.$(br2)Click it to throw it over or back; at a three-way junction clicks go round the ways.

$(l)Redstone$() sets it and holds it there. Sneak-click the stand to choose what redstone does: throw it, or hold it straight on. The marker on its post shows which (yellow, it throws; green, it holds) and lights while redstone holds it.$(br2)Trains coming out of either branch just run through.
A timetabled train sets the switch for the branch.

Timetabled trains set an unheld switch their way as they come to it; a held one they obey. Drivers' steering only counts at junctions with no switch.$(br2)Throwing a switch under a train doesn't split it: the cars behind follow the engine.
